name: Bybit BTC/USDT level-two order-flow imbalance
description: Standard best-quote event order-flow imbalance over completed atomic Bybit level-two delta groups. Bid contribution adds current size when bid price is unchanged or improves and subtracts prior size when unchanged or worsens; ask contribution subtracts current size when ask price is unchanged or improves and adds prior size when unchanged or worsens. Positive output represents net bid-side pressure and negative output net ask-side pressure, in BTC base units, over causal 1-, 10-, and 60-second receipt-time windows of (window close minus duration, window close]. Snapshots establish baselines and contribute no flow. Ready output requires 60 seconds of uninterrupted Bybit observation measured from a complete snapshot after startup or recovery, and Bybit demonstrably alive. An eventless book window on a live Bybit connection — any admitted Bybit input event within staleness_bound_ms — publishes truthful zero imbalance; no admitted Bybit input within that bound keeps degrading as book_snapshot_stale_or_missing, and a crossed, invalid, or unsnapshotted Bybit book still degrades. This identity is single-venue: it reads only Bybit inputs and is ready whenever Bybit is warmed and alive and its book is valid, independently of the other adopted spot venue. The blended `btc.external.*` reading of the same measurement stays the reference layer and continues to require every adopted venue (ADR 0024). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even. Venue port (B1): this identity is the Bybit sibling of `btc.coinbase.order_flow_imbalance@1.0.0` and reuses that definition's formulas, windows, thresholds, warm-up, staleness bound, field set, field types and eight-place round-half-to-even rounding verbatim; only the source ids differ (`crates/btc-signals/src/spot_signals.rs`, `crates/btc-signals/src/candidate_spot_signals.rs`). The instrument is Bybit spot BTCUSDT; this identity publishes no price-level field, so its outputs (base sizes, basis points, imbalances, ratios, counts) are quote-currency neutral and nothing is converted. Bybit inputs are rights-gated (`signals/knowledge/RIGHTS-LEDGER.md`): the lane is built and tested to the adopted standard, and its runtime refuses to start unless the environment allow-list `SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES` names `bybit`, which the deployment sets only after that row clears. The Bybit book input is the `orderbook.200.BTCUSDT` stream (100 ms, snapshot plus delta, 200 levels per side). `update_kind` carries the venue's own snapshot/delta semantics, so the Coinbase snapshot and delta rules port unchanged. Event time is the venue `cts` when present (`event_time_basis` = `source`) and the local receipt time otherwise (`receipt`). Ordering is the per-topic `update_id`; a repeated or lower id is dropped, and a delta before a seeding snapshot awaits a fresh snapshot. quote_currency is emitted on every decision and is the constant "usd" for this venue: this identity publishes no price-denominated field — its outputs are base sizes, ratios, basis-point and count fields, all quote-currency neutral — so nothing is converted. E47 (USD quoting): this identity quotes in USD and publishes no price, notional or quote-denominated cost field — its outputs are base sizes, counts, basis-point ratios and durations, which are quote-currency neutral — so nothing is converted and no usdt_usd_rate is published. quote_currency is the constant "usd".
